title: Cowgirl's Stew
ingredients: 400g can haricot beans, drained and rinsed
400g can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Put all ingredients except the pork into the slow-cooker bowl and stir together.
Place pork fillet in the pot; lid on; cook on high for 6–8 hours, or low for 10–12 hours.
Once cooked, use 2 forks to pull apart and mix the pork through the stew. Serve immediately.
notes: Add finely chopped pickled jalapeños for spice. Oven method: place all in a lidded casserole; cook at 200°C/180°C fan for 1½ hours.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
